# BG 5 editor fixtures

These Remotion sources come from the MotionSwift promotional film in
`motion-swift.rxfilmstudio`. They contain the procedural 3D rail, laptop, and
animated title. The test copies each project to a temporary directory before
editing it.

- `english` is “BG 5 — Waiting on the render (3D)”. Its title uses a JSX string expression.
- `chinese` is “BG 5 — 等待渲染（3D · 中文）”. Its title uses JSX text inside a scaled wrapper.
